chunks: Say: "To God belongs the consummate argument. Had He willed He would surely have guided all of you aright."

key_terms.الْبَالِغَةُ: The consummate, complete, or reaching its limit

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'Al-Hujjah Al-Balagha' in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, 'al-hujjah al-balagha' refers to the complete and conclusive proof God provides through the Prophets and Imams, leaving humanity without excuse. The verse underscores that guidance is ultimately a divine prerogative, yet human free will allows for the possibility of deviation despite the clarity of the message. This highlights the balance between divine omnipotence and the responsibility of individuals to accept the truth.
